description: Figure 3(a) illustrates the validation loss over training steps for the SMoE routing policy. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30,000, with tick labels at intervals of 5,000. The y-axis is labeled “Validation Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.50 to 2.25, with tick labels at intervals of 0.10. A single blue solid line represents the validation loss. Starting at approximately 2.22 at a training step of 0, the line declines to approximately 1.62 at a training step of 5,000, then continues to decline to approximately 1.54 at a training step of 10,000. Between 10,000 and 20,000 training steps, the line decreases further to approximately 1.51. From 20,000 to 30,000 training steps, the line remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 1.50.
